summary: This note describes "Peace on Earth / Little Drummer Boy", a Christmas song that combines the 1941 song "The Little Drummer Boy" with a counterpoint titled "Peace on Earth". The counterpoint's tune and lyrics were written by Ian Fraser, Larry Grossman, and Alan Kohan specifically for a recording by David Bowie and Bing Crosby. The song is sometimes also titled "The Little Drummer Boy / Peace on Earth".
one_line: A Christmas song pairing "The Little Drummer Boy" with a counterpoint, "Peace on Earth", recorded by David Bowie and Bing Crosby.
key_facts: "Peace on Earth / Little Drummer Boy" is a Christmas song with an added counterpoint performed by David Bowie and Bing Crosby.
The song is sometimes titled "The Little Drummer Boy / Peace on Earth".
"The Little Drummer Boy" is a Christmas song written in 1941.
The "Peace on Earth" tune and lyrics were written by Ian Fraser, Larry Grossman, and Alan Kohan.
The "Peace on Earth" tune and lyrics were added to "The Little Drummer Boy" specially for the recording by David Bowie and Bing Crosby.
The counterpoint was not part of the original 1941 composition of "The Little Drummer Boy".
